title: Classification of irreducible unitary modules over $\mathfrak{u}(p,q|n)$
summary: We classify all irreducible highest-weight unitary modules over the non-compact real form $\mathfrak{u}(p,q|n)$ of the general linear Lie superalgebra $\mathfrak{gl}_{p+q|n}$. The classification is given by explicit necessary and sufficient conditions on the highest weights, and our approach combines the Howe duality for $\mathfrak{gl}_{p+q|n}$ with a quadratic invariant of the maximal compact subalgebra.
